string.text: Drag a glowstick from your pack onto an artefact belt slot to wear it as a light. Detector-slot hold, throw, and existing keybinds still work. Taking it off the belt converts it back. Range/brightness apply to belt, held, and newly thrown sticks.
Scales each color's native range for belt, held, and newly thrown/dropped sticks (1.0 = native, up to 2x). Already-thrown sticks keep the values they spawned with.
Overall strength for belt, held, and newly thrown/dropped sticks (1.0 = native).
